title: euodia pteleifolia
intro: Euodia pteleifolia, commonly known as Chinese Prickly Ash, is a plant species within the Rutaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Euodia pteleifolia include analgesic, anti-arthritic, and antipyretic effects, as well as a potential ability to reduce blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of Euodia pteleifolia include limonoids, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
